description: Catalog of multi-sub-agent workflows. Search-capable stages are time-horizon independent: the same agent handles day/week/month/year questions by passing time_range on Tavily tools. Each flow assigns a specific functional role to every participating sub-agent and lists the problem classes that combination can solve.

flows.name: General Research Agent Composed Flow
flows.description: A composed flow that leverages the general research capabilities of the general_research_agent to provide a foundation for more specialized sub-agents.
problem_types: Open-ended factual research needing live web data
Current-events or multi-source summaries without a specialist niche
1-week vs 1-month research questions answered by the same agent via time_range
example_queries: Summarize the latest developments on renewable energy policy this week
What are the key macro headlines this month?
Compare this week's vs this month's news on semiconductor supply

flows.name: General Web Research
flows.description: Open-ended research and synthesis using topic-scoped finance/general/news search. Horizon-flexible: the same primary_deep_agent handles this-week vs this-month (or day/year) queries via time_range on each tool call.
problem_types: Open-ended factual research needing live web data
Current-events or multi-source summaries without a specialist niche
1-week vs 1-month research questions answered by the same agent via time_range
example_queries: Summarize the latest developments on renewable energy policy this week
What are the key macro headlines this month?
Compare this week's vs this month's news on semiconductor supply

stages.function: Gather live snippets via finance/general/news search with time_range matched to the user horizon; synthesize an answer

flows.name: Indian Equity Investment Pipeline
flows.description: End-to-end Indian equity decisioning: research report (horizon via market_analyst time_range) -> SEBI-aligned critique -> multi-horizon CIO verdict. Research stage is not locked to one lookback window.
problem_types: Full Indian equity investment decision for a ticker or sector
Institutional-style research followed by buy/sell/hold across 1Q/1Y/3Y
SEBI-compliant report finalization before capital allocation
Indian equity research scoped to a user-requested window (1 week vs 1 month vs longer) via time_range
example_queries: Analyze RELIANCE and give a 1Q/1Y/3Y investment verdict
Build an Indian equity research pack on banking sector for the past month and recommend action
Produce a SEBI-aligned report on TCS using this week's data and finalize BUY/SELL/HOLD

stages.function: Produce SEBI-aligned analysis with finance_web_search time_range matched to the user horizon (day/week/month/year); persist detailed tables to files
Critique the report for missing Indian metrics, numbering consistency, and PASS/FAIL
Issue multi-horizon BUY/SELL/HOLD verdicts with confidence from the finalized report

flows.name: Indian Market Research (Report Only)
flows.description: Stop after research: SEBI-aligned market analysis without critique or CIO verdict. market_analyst selects time_range (day/week/month/year) from the user's requested lookback.
problem_types: Indian equity/sector research report without an investment action
Market sizing, CAGR, and fundamental snapshot for NSE/BSE names
Weekly vs monthly Indian market research via the same market_analyst agent
example_queries: Write a fundamental snapshot of HDFC Bank with key metrics for the past month
Size the Indian EV sector using this week's data
Compare 1-week vs 1-month sector momentum for IT

stages.function: Produce executive summary + metrics table; pass finance_web_search time_range for the requested window

flows.name: Indian Near-Term Trade Pick
flows.description: Single-specialist Indian equity trade recommendation. Horizon-flexible: the same indian_stock_trader_3m agent answers 1-week vs 1-month (or day/~3-month) questions by passing time_range on finance_web_search.
problem_types: Near-term Indian stock pick with risk-reward framing
1-week Indian equity trade idea (time_range=week)
1-month Indian equity trade idea (time_range=month)
Dated / same-day NSE/BSE trade setup (time_range=day)
example_queries: Recommend one Indian stock for a trade on 13 Aug with high upside and safer downside
Give a 1-week Indian equity trade idea with confidence
Give a 1-month Indian equity trade idea with confidence
Compare a 1-week vs 1-month view for NIFTY banking names

stages.function: Select and justify an Indian equity trade; set finance_web_search time_range from the user horizon (day/week/month/year)

flows.name: Equity Report Quality Gate
flows.description: Critique an existing Indian equity report for SEBI standards and metric gaps. (No live search / time_range — operates on provided report text.)
problem_types: Review/edit pass on an Indian equity research draft
PASS/FAIL validation before publishing an equity memo
example_queries: Critique this Indian equity report for missing P/E, ROCE, promoter holding
Is this SEBI-style memo ready to finalize?

stages.function: Flag critical gaps and issue PASS/FAIL without rewriting the full report

flows.name: US Flexible-Horizon Trade Pick
flows.description: US equity recommendation with high-conviction setups. Horizon-flexible: the same us_stock_trader_3m agent answers 1-week vs 1-month (or day/~3-month) questions via finance_web_search time_range — not locked to three months only.
problem_types: US stock recommendation for a user-requested horizon (week/month/day/year)
1-week US equity trade idea (time_range=week)
1-month / ~3-month US equity trade idea (time_range=month)
High-conviction US equity trade ideas with risk framing
example_queries: Recommend a US stock for a 1-week horizon with high upside
Recommend a US stock for a 1-month horizon with high upside
Pick one high-conviction US equity trade for the next quarter
Compare this week's vs this month's setup for NVDA

stages.function: Recommend a US equity for the user-requested horizon using finance_web_search with matching time_range
